subject.title: agent-core: parallel batch runs a prepared paid tool after the run is aborted mid-batch

question: Which candidate fix should be the canonical landing path for this prepared parallel-tool abort race?
rationale: Two open PRs close this issue and touch the same agent-core boundary; one has sufficient real behavior proof and the other is a duplicate candidate, so a maintainer should choose the landing path before the issue can close.

options.title: Land the proof-sufficient candidate
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102276, then close the duplicate candidate and this issue after merge.

options.title: Choose the sibling candidate
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102283 only if maintainers prefer that branch and require comparable proof before merge.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Keep this issue open if maintainers want a different cancellation architecture than the shared `executePreparedToolCall` guard.

recommendation.title: Land the proof-sufficient candidate
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102276, then close the duplicate candidate and this issue after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current packaged agent-core loop history points to `vincentkoc`, making them the best available routing owner for the duplicate-fix choice.
